intervention_space: exactly ONE body parameter changed to a value inside morphology.BOUNDS (out-of-range is rejected, never clipped); gait/controller parameters are out of scope

call_plan.purpose: identical prompt to enriched-1, sampled at temperature 0.7 to expose proposal variability

stop_rules: stop before a request if requests_made >= 3
stop before a request if tokens_used + estimated_prompt_tokens + max_tokens > 18000
stop after any request if tokens_used >= 18000
no prompt edits and no extra requests after seeing any result

tier_rule.success: primary-push held-out fall rate <= 0.2 AND candidate fall rate <= baseline at EVERY push level AND primary mean survival time >= baseline
tier_rule.partial: not success, but primary fall rate reduced by >= 0.3
tier_rule.none: otherwise (a better secondary metric alone never counts)

trial_status_mapping: accepted == tier success; everything else (incl. partial) is rejected_by_verifier; invalid replies, errors and budget stops are preserved as their own statuses

random.description: uniform parameter, uniform value in bounds; sees no evidence and no results; every proposal judged by the same held-out protocol; reported as per-proposal success rate (matches Nemotron's budget of ONE proposal) plus analytic best-of-k

heuristic.prior_knowledge_disclosure: author knew longer feet widen the support polygon and that foot length mattered in Phase 0; the x1.5 factor was fixed before any candidate was evaluated (x1.5 -> 0.12 m, not the 16 cm answer)

exploration_disclosure: seeds 100-105 and pushes 10-40 N were used on 2026-10-13 to characterise the baseline and 16 cm frontier (baseline survives 15 N, falls >= 20 N; 16 cm survives <= 30 N, falls >= 35 N). Held-out seeds 200-209 were never used for exploration, evidence or screening.
claims_policy: no claim that Nemotron outperforms any baseline from <= 3 exploratory trials; report counts, budgets (model calls, tokens, simulations) and limitations
